description: The Department of War Activity (DWIA) intends to award a single source purchase order to LIONSGATE FILMS INC., CAGE Code: 5BS75, located at 2700 Colorado Avenue, Suite 200, Santa Monica, California, 90404-5502, United States. The intent of this award is to acquire proprietary television and movie programming content, including the broadcast distribution rights for a mixture of prime time and non-prime time television programming for AFN outlets overseas.
